headline: Executive order directs stronger collection of antidumping and countervailing duties and tougher enforcement of trade and customs laws.
what_it_does: This order tells federal agencies to do a better job collecting antidumping and countervailing duties. These are extra tariffs placed on imports that are sold below fair value or helped by foreign government subsidies. It also calls for stronger enforcement against violations of US trade and customs laws. The title does not give details on the specific steps agencies must take.

who_it_affects.how: Companies that bring in goods subject to these duties may face stricter collection and enforcement.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign exporters selling to the US
who_it_affects.how: Exporters whose goods face antidumping or countervailing duties may see those duties enforced more closely.
Domestic producers that sought these duties may see them collected more fully.
Agencies that handle imports are directed to step up duty collection and enforcement.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 31, 2017; the specific effective date is not stated in the title.
